## Data acceptance evidence and boundaries

Executed all 18 Data methods and 18 foundation methods successfully. Data tests include deterministic execution of only test-authored parser/normalizer code, positive frozen fixture, new correction preserving predecessors, permission positive path, exact-reference mismatch, path aliases, feature latest availability, closing/outcome evaluation restrictions, canonical membership equality and partial overlap, acyclic dependency checks, quarantine retention/global scope, and trusted-checkpoint/digest/predecessor checks. New Skeptic tests reach persisted repository-level attacks with compatible artifacts rather than relying only on direct helper calls.

**Underlying attacks prevented/detected within Data's contract:** absent/wrong typed input manifests; unknown and late availability; post-availability corrections; evaluation inputs in decision lineage; changed raw bytes; inconsistent assembled snapshots even with fresh hashes; self/orphan supersession; published byte mutation/deletion against supplied accepted history; malformed identifiers/filenames/versions; future completed facts; invalid source permission evidence. These are scoped control results, not closure of H04/H06/M01/M02 in their entirety.

**Underlying attacks still successful:** unsupported paper states and resurrection; operational OPEN STOP bypass and arbitrary-file resolution; self-issued role approvals; complete experiment claims with absent reproduction/results; explored and renamed populations reused as confirmatory. Those match the remaining Research/Quant/Risk assignments, not undisclosed completion of their work by Data. Structural-only validation accepts history mutation/deletion; a trusted-baseline comparison correctly detects it. No trusted external operational checkpoint or reviewer channel is provisioned, and the initial CLI baseline protects its own historical inventory, not every later publication. Choosing HEAD controlled by a submitter would not be independent acceptance.

**Data remediation required from this consultation: none newly demonstrated.** Supporting primitives do not imply downstream enforcement. This is a bounded review of the requested attacks, not proof against arbitrary fabricated external timestamps, identity remapping, code semantics or unknown defects. Canonical upstream sample identity remains an explicit assumption; manifest renaming cannot hide equality, but dishonest new event/namespace identities require provenance/identity review.

Research retains structured exploratory ancestry, prior exposure, frozen protocol and first-access contracts. Quant retains exact reproduction code/environment/config/output/trial bundles, failed-trial completeness and same/renamed/partially overlapping sample exposure denial. Risk retains lifecycle and terminality, actor authority, operational dependency graph, authoritative STOP resolution/eligibility and descendant release, event-derived project state, freshness, paper controls and kill-switch integration. Director retains external trust/acceptance coordination and scheduling. No new Data remediation handoff is warranted by these results; existing owner handoffs remain open.
